properties.displayName: [WEEKLY] Server / AI-agent process spawns shell or LOLBIN with public egress — post-RCE behavioural chain
properties.description:
Detects long-running server or agent processes (node, java, python, dotnet, nginx workers, xrdp, portainer, deepseek-tui, n8n, flowise, ruby, perl, php-fpm) spawning interactive shells (cmd/powershell/sh/bash) or network LOLBINs (curl/wget/certutil/bitsadmin/nc/ncat/socat), correlated with public-internet egress from the same host within 5 minutes — or with shell-decode / download-cradle markers in the child command line. This fortnight produced 12 disparate RCE disclosures whose post-exploit fingerprint collapses to the same behaviour: n8n HTTP-Request prototype pollution (CVE-2026-44789), NGINX rewrite heap overflow exploited in the wild (CVE-2026-42945 / 42946 / 40701 / 42934), Portainer plugin auth bypass to host RCE (CVE-2026-44848), FlowiseAI NodeVM sandbox escape (CVE-2026-46442), DeepSeek-TUI run_tests + task_create insecure defaults (CVE-2026-45311 / 45374), Mapfish Print dynamic-table injection (CVE-2026-44672), esm.sh path traversal (CVE-2026-44593), xrdp pre-auth RCE (CVE-2025-68670), Ivanti EPMM (CVE-2026-6973), and Microsoft's AI-agent frameworks advisory (CVE-2026-26030 / 25592). The kill chain spans exploit through install / c2 — it fires when an RCE primitive lands and the operator pivots from in-process code execution to a real shell or a second-stage downloader. Fires when a watched server parent spawns a shell/LOLBIN AND the child either reaches a public IP within 5 minutes OR carries decode/download cradles in its command line; does NOT fire on routine CI/build activity (npm/cargo/gradle/mvn/pip/go-test/jest/pytest/eslint/prettier/webpack) suppressed via parent and child command-line regex, nor on benign shell spawns that never egress and lack cradle markers.

Rationale: Every one of the 12 articles ends the same way regardless of the exploit primitive: a trusted long-running server / AI-agent / workflow process gains the ability to run code and the operator immediately reaches for a shell or a network-staging LOLBIN. Anchoring on the parent-child pair (server-host → shell/LOLBIN) plus a 5-minute time-windowed correlation to public egress on the same PID promotes a hunch into an alert without depending on the rotating CVE-, hash-, or IP-level IOCs in any individual article.
properties.query:
let _server_parents = dynamic(["node.exe","node","java.exe","java","javaw.exe","python.exe","python","python3","pythonw.exe","dotnet.exe","dotnet","nginx.exe","nginx","xrdp","xrdp-sesman","portainer.exe","portainer","deepseek-tui.exe","deepseek-tui","n8n.exe","n8n","flowise","ruby.exe","ruby","perl","go","php-fpm"]);
let _shells_lolbins = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","sh","bash","zsh","dash","ksh","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe","curl","curl.exe","wget","wget.exe","nc","ncat","socat"]);
let _build_noise = @"(?i)(npm\s+(test|install|run|ci)|cargo\s+(test|build|run)|gradle\s|mvn\s+(install|test|package)|pip\s+install|go\s+test|jest|pytest|eslint|prettier|webpack)";
let _cradle = @"(?i)(base64\s+-d|/dev/tcp/|bash\s+-i|powershell\s+-(e|enc)|FromBase64String|IEX |Invoke-Expression|DownloadString|certutil\s+-urlcache|wget\s+http|curl\s+-s\s+http)";
let _spawn = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
    | extend ParentLeaf = tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1])
    | extend ParentLeaf = iif(ParentLeaf == "", tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "/")[-1]), ParentLeaf)
    | extend ChildLeaf = tostring(split(TargetProcessName, "\\")[-1])
    | extend ChildLeaf = iif(ChildLeaf == "", tostring(split(TargetProcessName, "/")[-1]), ChildLeaf)
    | where ParentLeaf in~ (_server_parents)
    | where ChildLeaf in~ (_shells_lolbins)
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | where not(TargetProcessCommandLine matches regex _build_noise)
    | where not(ParentProcessCommandLine matches regex _build_noise)
    | project SpawnTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
              ParentLeaf, ParentCmd = ParentProcessCommandLine,
              ChildLeaf, ChildCmd = TargetProcessCommandLine, ChildPid = TargetProcessId;
let _egress = ImNetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
    | where EventResult in ("Success","") or isempty(EventResult)
    | where isnotempty(DstIpAddr) and not(ipv4_is_private(DstIpAddr))
    | project NetTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, NetProc = ActingProcessName, NetPid = ActingProcessId, DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber, Url;
_spawn
| join kind=leftouter _egress on DvcHostname, $left.ChildPid == $right.NetPid
| extend EgressWithinWindow = iif(isnotnull(NetTime) and datetime_diff('second', NetTime, SpawnTime) between (0 .. 300), true, false)
| extend SuspiciousCmd = ChildCmd matches regex _cradle
| where EgressWithinWindow or SuspiciousCmd
| project SpawnTime, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ParentLeaf, ParentCmd, ChildLeaf, ChildCmd, ChildPid, DstIpAddr, DstPortNumber, Url, NetTime, EgressWithinWindow, SuspiciousCmd
| order by SpawnTime desc
